items.html: The fourth correction: the pure wool that hangs in the scales. Know, that the NH have two discernments in every place: the first is the heads of the joints of the thighs, which are above the Yesod; the second is their spreading below the Yesod. And besides this they have an internal aspect, which is higher than the Yesod, and they are sealed from within, and they are the two testicles of the male, where the seed is cooked, and from them it is drawn below them into the Yesod. And so it is also in the NH of the female.
